title: shrink
body:
## shrink

Moves the points of every cell towards that cell's centroid (the average of its points) so that cells separate from their neighbours, and outputs an unstructured grid in which no point is shared between cells. It is a mesh-inspection aid that reveals cell shapes, sizes and gaps inside a volume or surface mesh; point and cell arrays travel with the cells. factor is the fraction of each cell's size kept (Schemaxis default 0.8; ParaView's own default is 0.5).

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Every shared point is duplicated once per cell, so point count and memory grow several-fold on volume meshes; shrink a slice, surface or extracted subset of a large mesh instead.
- Do not measure or integrate the result: shrinking scales each cell's area by factor squared and its volume by factor cubed.
- Schemaxis's serial native acceptance run (examples/schemaxis/extended-coverage.json) executes this operation once, on a sphere with the default factor; it does not check this operation's output values, so inspect the result on your own data.

Native constructor: `Shrink`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `factor` | The value of this property determines how far the points will move. A value of 0 positions the points at the centroid of the cell. A value of 1 leaves them at their original positions. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":1}` | `0.8` | `0.8` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "shrink",
  "inputs": {
    "input": "UPSTREAM_input"
  }
}
```
